property_summary: For all callers and newOwner addresses, only the contract owner can successfully call transferOwnership on the correct contract (calls by non-owners revert); the mutant removes the onlyOwner check allowing non-owners to transfer ownership, so some fuzzed caller will succeed there while the correct contract would revert.
change_summary: Change onlyOwner guard to allow anyone to call transferOwnership by removing the modifier invocation.
